crossRefs.note: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and…
I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false…
for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather…

parallels.note: The river will swarm with frogs, which will go up and come into your house, and into your bedroom, and on your bed, and…

translations.web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
translations.bsb: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
translations.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
translations.asv: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.
